visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a short buzz cut, wearing a black t-shirt featuring a cartoon dinosaur graphic and black shorts, sits comfortably on a dark stone block. He is positioned next to a grey stone statue of a character with round ears and a bell, resting on a tiered circular pedestal. The setting is an outdoor area with a textured brick wall and grey stone blocks under bright, direct sunlight. (2) The man extends his right arm toward the grey stone character statue, slowly placing the palm of his hand onto the very top of its rounded head. He looks directly at the camera with a wide smile, seemingly unaware of the surface temperature at first, while the bright sunlight creates sharp shadows on the brick wall behind him. (3) He immediately recoils his hand with a sharp, jerky motion, opening his mouth in a loud shout and squinting his eyes in a grimace of sudden heat. He looks toward the camera, his expression shifting from pain to a forced laugh, while he holds his hand away from the object and looks back at the statue in surprise.
